summary_md:
# #455 75-procentig hit rate

**Feed**: market-makers  
**Published**: 2026-10-29  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The Market Makers hosts start with news: a Borr Drilling rig sank off Gabon, Yubico rallied with cybersecurity and AI-security stocks, Anthropic filed its S-1, and Microsoft offered voluntary buyouts to staff. Most of the episode is bullish on picks-and-shovels companies for the data-centre boom (Munters, Bravida, Byggpartner) and introduces MSAB as a new idea. They also follow up on old picks: they buy back into Nelly, sell all of Qliro because the thesis broke, and add to Acast after its record quarter.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 MTRS — Munters | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 80%

Margin has bottomed, CEO bullish on data-centre margins and sales above SEK 11bn in 2027. Short interest above 5%. CMD catalyst. Host holds a large position.

#### Reasoning

The weak Q3 margin comes from a temporary US plant ramp that improved during the quarter. The CEO signals data-centre sales above SEK 11bn in 2027, putting the stock around EV/EBITA 9, which is cheap. Short interest above 5% has historically marked good entry points. A CMD in about two weeks may bring new targets. Peer Vertiv rose 17%, which suggests the sector sell-off was an overreaction.

#### Sell Triggers

- data-centre order intake weakens
- margin ramp in the US plant stalls
- CMD disappoints

> *"Jag tycker dessutom ett väldigt bra läge i aktien just nu faktiskt."*

---

### 🟢 BRAV — Bravida | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Data-centre pipeline growing, order book up 70%+ and at a record high, can choose projects so margins rise. Host took a small position.

#### Reasoning

Bravida has a long data-centre track record (Meta Luleå) and recent large wins, including over SEK 4bn in Norway. Demand exceeds capacity, so it can pick higher-margin projects. Data centres drove a third of growth on top of the base business. The stock is already up about 70% YTD, which is why the position is small.

#### Sell Triggers

- data-centre pipeline slows
- order book declines

> *"Så jag har även en liten position i Bravida, tog jag in i portföljen också."*

---

### 🟢 BYGGP — Byggpartner | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host bought some on the data-centre theme. Looks depressed, and less competition in other segments helps all builders.

#### Reasoning

Data-centre work soaks up construction capacity, which reduces competition in other segments and helps builders with little data-centre exposure, such as Byggpartner. The host thinks the stock looks depressed.

#### Sell Triggers

- data-centre construction boom fades

> *"Jag har faktiskt också köpt in lite... byggbolag, byggpartner på den här tesen."*

---

### 🟢 YUBICO — Yubico | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Momentum and trading on the cybersecurity/AI-security theme, volume about 10x normal. Hosts hold small positions and plan to sell before the 15 Nov report.

#### Reasoning

Cybersecurity is hot because AI makes attacks easier, and Yubico is OpenAI's hardware-key partner. Heavy volume suggests large buyers. It trades around P/E 30 on 2027, below US peers. The hosts see it as a momentum trade with a stop loss and no long-term thesis. Revenue has declined in recent reports.

#### Sell Triggers

- before the 15 Nov report
- stop loss hit
- momentum fades

> *"jag har handlat runt det här i veckan, rider vågen lite, kommer nog sälja innan rapport 15 november"*

---

### 🟡 BORR — Borr Drilling | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Losing the Prospector 5 rig costs about 5% of mid-cycle EBITDA. Likely insured. Host keeps the position as a high-risk part of his oil basket.

#### Reasoning

Losing one Tier 1 rig is a small hit. Precedent (a similar 2013 punch-through accident) suggests insurance covered most costs and the driller kept working for the client. The open risk is that the accident investigation hurts contract tendering in 2027. The host sees Borr as an option on the capex cycle.

#### Sell Triggers

- Borr finds it harder to contract rigs
- insurance doesn't cover costs
- large fines/liabilities

> *"Jag har fortfarande kvar en position i i borr då jag inte tycker att det här bryter tesen."*

---

### 🟠 MSAB-B — MSAB (Micro Systemation) | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Strong operational inflection: EBIT margin 41%, two positive profit warnings, SEK 1bn sales target by 2030, more than half of revenue recurring. Host has no position because of the 70% YTD run.

#### Reasoning

Mobile-forensics demand is a secular trend across 100+ countries, and the CEO's investments are paying off. About EV/EBIT 14 next year and 12 in 2028 is fair, or even cheap if growth lasts. Strong owner list. Risk: lumpy government contracts and a possible one-off spending wave. The host finds it very interesting but is wary of what is already priced in.

#### Sell Triggers

- growth proves to be a one-off government spending wave
- contract renewals fail

> *"Jag tycker att det är lite läskigare här i att det har gått upp så pass mycket."*

---

### 🟢 NELLY — Nelly | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Q3 growth +10% with flat EBIT, October better than H1. Trailing EV/EBIT 6 against a fair 9 implies about 50% upside. Host bought a small to medium position.

#### Reasoning

Fundamentals appear to have bottomed: hiring is slowing, sales are growing again, and Q4 started better. Clothing retailers rarely trade below EV/EBIT 9. A strong NOK helps and a good dividend may come early next year. Risks: CEO departure, two CFO exits in six months, and a sector-wide tailwind flattering the numbers.

#### Sell Triggers

- Q4 fails to improve
- further management turnover issues

> *"Men tycker att det är för billigt nu och det ser ut som att det har bottnat ut"*

---

### 🔴 QLIRO — Qliro | **SELL** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Q3 broke the inflection thesis: 2027 growth guided down, volumes slowed, break-even only via a one-off. Host sold all shares.

#### Reasoning

The thesis was accelerating revenue and profit into H2. Instead, management guided 2027 growth lower, volumes slowed sharply, profit relied on a one-off gain, and part of the acceleration came from renegotiated contracts that are now fading. The timeline slips to 2028 at best. The host is avoiding 'thesis creep' and has exited.

> *"Så jag sålde alla mina aktier. på att tesen bröts."*

---

### 🟢 ACAST — Acast | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Record Q3 (25% growth, 10% adjusted EBITA margin, operating profit tripled), yet the stock fell 10% on selling by large holders. Host bought more and keeps his core holding.

#### Reasoning

Execution is on plan, the Spotify skip button is dismissed as a non-story, and the move toward omnichannel advertising deepens advertiser relationships. The drop came from the 3rd/4th largest owners selling 6% since April, which should ease, and analyst upgrades may follow. Watch points: growth delta slowing and flat revenue per listen quarter on quarter.

#### Sell Triggers

- growth deceleration deepens
- Spotify partnership deteriorates
- ARPL stagnates

> *"Jag köpte mer aktier helt enkelt för att jag tyckte inte att det här var reflekterade rapporter överhuvudtaget."*

---
